editPolicy.seatedBlockPolicy: The six former directional blocks repeat the same five front-facing animation phases. They preserve the original 660-cell layout without adding side/back seated poses.
editPolicy.packing: Exact grid registration with alpha-preserving resizing and mirrored directional views.

quadruped-professor.description: Thoughtful Onyx in the existing full-body quadruped atlas before the dedicated Professor rise.

clipRules: Select walking by current posture; never loop all five mixed walking slots as one cycle.
Use the directional quadruped and biped walk frames with 135 ms frame timing.
Use the 630 ms rise and reverse-rise clips once; wait for their endpoints before switching renderers.
Turn in place by stepping through directional professor_stand frames; do not reuse the quadruped-to-biped spin as a couch turn.
Keep seated Professor clips front-facing and cycle the six equivalent five-frame seated blocks for small posture changes.
Before leaving the seat, play sit_prepare, stand, walk away, then the reverse rise and quadruped walk.
Keep the ground anchor at y=60/64 and hand off only at a quadruped frame boundary.

handoff.preferredMatch: f000 plus directionIndex * 5 after exit; preserved walk_quadruped IDs for an ongoing walk

prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / compositing.
Asset type: exact, transparent game sprite replacement contact sheet for Onyx professor.
Input image 1 is the approved 30-column, 22-row base-cat atlas. Preserve that exact cat identity and small sprite rendering style. Input image 2 shows the professor pose reference rendered from the user's SVG files. Use its brown tweed blazer, white shirt, small green bow tie, olive trousers, brown shoes, thin round spectacles, black cat paws, spin-to-biped choreography, seated clipboard, and rise/walk posture. The professor is the SAME Onyx, a long slender sleek all-black domestic shorthair, with long legs, long tail, pointed ears, small green irises, black nose, white-and-black whiskers. Do not change him into a different chubby cat or give him yellow eyes. Shirt white is clothing, NEVER white fur.

Produce ONLY a replacement-pose sprite sheet, not the original full 660-frame atlas. Exact composition: a wide landscape canvas 1920 x 704 pixels, an EXACT uniform 30-column by 11-row grid, total 330 separate sprites. Each invisible cell is 64 x 64. No margins, no labels, no visible grid, no background, no shadows, no extra illustration, no gaps of missing cells. Populate every cell and every row all the way to the bottom. Sprites must stay fully INSIDE their cell including tail and feet, with 3px breathing space, centered horizontally, consistent ground baseline y=60 inside each cell. Upright figures should be around 54px high, quadrupeds 48px wide. Keep same physical cat scale across all poses and no changing face or fur. Maintain transparent RGBA background.

The columns are SIX consecutive groups of FIVE animation phases, not random repeats. Columns 1–5 face RIGHT (side); 6–10 face DOWN-RIGHT (front three-quarter); 11–15 face DOWN-LEFT (front three-quarter); 16–20 face LEFT (side); 21–25 face UP-LEFT (rear three-quarter); 26–30 face UP-RIGHT (rear three-quarter). Every five-cell group is the same action in five consecutive stages and MUST maintain that viewing direction through the action. Rear views show backs of heads, jackets and trousers, no front-facing eyes.

Eleven row instructions, top to bottom:
ROW 1: professor walking on TWO hind legs, five clean sequential steps, gentle alternating paw-arm swing; fully dressed biped in every cell, and all six viewing directions.
ROW 2: slow rise transformation, five stages: (1) unclothed base-cat on all four legs, (2) hind legs plant, front legs start lifting, (3) half-upright balanced on hind legs, blazer/trousers begin appearing, (4) almost fully upright dressed cat forepaws bent, (5) full professor standing on two legs. Keep anatomy coherent, one head and one tail.
ROW 3: quick spin transformation, five stages: base-cat quadruped, beginning turn/lifting, rising half-biped with delicate warm grey motion ribbon close to body, near-upright wearing outfit, fully upright professor. The ribbon must not overlap cells and not hide anatomy.
ROW 4: crouch-to-upright transformation, five stages: base-cat quadruped, hindquarter crouch preparing, hindlegs extend and chest rises, near-upright professor, professor fully on two legs.
ROW 5: small hop-to-upright transformation, five stages: base-cat quadruped, forepaws lift with hind paws on ground, small upright hind-leg hop, dressed biped hindleg landing, balanced fully upright professor. No flying quadrupeds at the end.
ROW 6: biped professor SEATED low on an invisible seat, knees bent forward like seated person, torso upright, forepaws resting on thighs. Five small postural settling stages. No cat loaf.
ROW 7: biped professor SEATED low, shifts his weight and leans forward to listen, forepaws on knees, slight head tilts over five phases. No quadruped lounge.
ROW 8: biped professor SEATED upright, listening attentively, small head nod and forepaw gestures, five consecutive poses.
ROW 9: biped professor SEATED comfortably, clipboard across his lap, paws reposition it and write with pencil, five consecutive poses.
ROW 10: biped professor SEATED, one leg crossed over the other, clipboard on lap, paw briefly touches spectacles and returns to notes, five consecutive poses.
ROW 11: biped professor SEATED relaxed with clipboard, leans back slightly then sits forward preparing to rise, five consecutive poses, always visibly seated biped.

Most important: count exactly 30 columns and 11 rows; no giant images, no captions. ONE sprite per cell. All sprites same black cat identity as input 1. Outfit and poses from input 2, but adapt realistic professor to the subtle game-sprite style of input 1. This is a dense production animation sheet that will be cropped into 64px frames. No black or opaque backdrop: real transparency.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: game sprite replacement sheet, professor Onyx seated only.
Inputs: image 1 is the approved base cat atlas and defines Onyx's black fur, slender long domestic shorthair physique, pointed ears, small green eyes and small sprite style. Image 2 is the user's professor SVG pose reference rendered as a contact sheet; use its professor wardrobe and seated clipboard pose. Image 3 is the newly generated professor replacement sheet; match its small game-sprite rendering and EXACT professor appearance. Keep the same black cat identity throughout: a slender long black cat, one head, two forepaws, two hind legs, one long black tail, not pudgy. Brown tweed blazer, white SHIRT (no white fur), green bow tie, dark olive trousers, brown shoes, thin round spectacles, green eyes with tiny black pupils. The black cat paws have no human skin.
Create a new sheet consisting of EXACTLY FIVE COLUMNS by SIX ROWS, exactly THIRTY sprites, regular invisible square-cell grid, with true transparent RGBA background. Canvas 800 x 960, each cell 160 x 160. No extra sprites, no missing cells, no text or labels, no grid lines, no furniture, no ground shadow, no decorations. Ground baseline at y=150 within each cell. Sprites completely contained in their cells, full cat body and tail uncropped, approx 135px tall, no enlarged face closeups. Match tiny game-sprite subtle shaded style, not a new cartoon.
CRITICAL correction: EVERY SINGLE sprite is a BIPED PROFESSOR SITTING FACING STRAIGHT FORWARD TOWARD THE VIEWER. There are NO side views or back views anywhere. His face, chest, both knees and both front-facing shoes are visible. Head can tilt but torso remains forward. Sitting like a human with bent knees, forepaws free for gestures, pelvis visibly seated on an invisible seat. Never on all fours, never a cat loaf, never lying down, never standing or walking.
Each row is five consecutive frames of ONE small animated posture sequence, all front-facing:
ROW 1: seated upright, paws on thighs; subtle settling and breathing, five phases.
ROW 2: seated leaning slightly forward to listen, paws on knees; five small weight shifts and nods.
ROW 3: seated listening upright, one paw makes a calm explanatory gesture then rests on thigh; five stages.
ROW 4: seated relaxed, clipboard lies across lap; look down, pencil writes, look up, repeat; five stages.
ROW 5: seated with one hind leg crossed over the other, clipboard on lap; paw adjusts spectacles then returns to notes; five stages.
ROW 6: seated leaning back slightly, clipboard held against lap; gradually leans forward and places one paw on knee while still visibly SITTING in all five frames, preparing to stand later; five stages.
Do not copy the multi-directional seated rows from image 3. Replace them with forward-only seated postures, using row 3 of image 2 as the anatomy and wardrobe guide. Exactly 5 columns, 6 rows. Every frame belongs to the SAME cat, consistent green eye color, sleek all-black head and paws, consistent body length and slenderness. Genuine transparent background.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: Onyx professor locomotion and transformation sprite sheet.
Image 1 approved base cat atlas is the cat identity. Image 2 professor SVG pose reference gives wardrobe, spin and biped walking. Image 3 previous generated replacement sheet gives final tiny sprite rendering style. Create improved directional locomotion and coherent rising transitions matching those sprites. The same long, slender sleek ALL-BLACK domestic shorthair in EVERY frame. Green eyes, slender cat face and pointed ears, black nose, long tail, no white fur. Professor wardrobe brown tweed blazer, white shirt, small green bow tie, olive trousers, brown shoes, thin round spectacles. No human skin or hands. Retain black cat paws.

EXACT grid FIVE COLUMNS by NINE ROWS, 45 sprites total, canvas 800x1440 with invisible 160x160 square cells, true transparent RGBA. No text, labels, borders, furniture, shadow or extra frames. Every sprite contained in cell with 8px breathing space, ground y=150 per cell. Upright height135px; quadruped width135px, shoulder about65px high. Same physical animal scale throughout. Match subtle shaded game sprite style, NOT plush/cartoon. One head and one long tail rooted at pelvis in every frame.
There are ONLY three viewing directions. Each row maintains its stated view across all FIVE frames. NO turns between phases except localized body spin in final rows. DIRECTIONS: right-side profile (head toward right), down-right FRONT three-quarter (chest visible and nose toward lower-right), up-left REAR three-quarter (back of jacket and back of head visible, nose toward upper-left, no visible face).
Rows top to bottom:
1 RIGHT-SIDE PROFILE biped walking five phases: right hind leg contacts ahead and left trails; right stance and left passing; LEFT leg contacts ahead and right trails; left stance and right passing; right contacts ahead again. This MUST visibly alternate both legs. Cat forepaws alternate gently as arms; fully dressed, on two hind legs.
2 DOWN-RIGHT FRONT THREE-QUARTER biped walking the same five alternating step phases. Head directed down-right throughout, chest diagonal, not straight front.
3 UP-LEFT REAR THREE-QUARTER biped walking the same five alternating step phases. Show back and tail; NO front of shirt or face. Alternate which shoe heel lifts. Direction points upper-left.
4 RIGHT-SIDE PROFILE slow rise, five stages: unclothed long slender quadruped base cat; hindlegs plant and forepaws barely lift; chest rises half way with spine angled and paws free; hindlegs extend with outfit materializing; fully dressed professor standing upright in profile.
5 DOWN-RIGHT FRONT THREE-QUARTER slow rise, identical five stages, preserve down-right orientation INCLUDING quadruped and intermediate phases.
6 UP-LEFT REAR THREE-QUARTER slow rise, identical five stages, preserve rear up-left orientation INCLUDING quadruped and intermediates. See rump, back, rear paws and back of head; do not show right-facing side view for quadruped.
7 RIGHT-SIDE PROFILE spin rise, five stages: unclothed quadruped; forepaws lift and small warm grey ribbon begins around trunk; half-risen biped turning briefly, clothes beginning; near-upright dressed professor small spin ribbon fading; stable dressed standing professor in right-side profile, ribbon gone.
8 DOWN-RIGHT FRONT THREE-QUARTER spin rise, same five stages, final professor down-right three-quarter; no frontal ending.
9 UP-LEFT REAR THREE-QUARTER spin rise, same five stages, final professor rear up-left view; no frontal ending.

The quadruped and biped are the SAME cat at the same scale; its slender long torso rotates upright, it never shrinks into a round kitten. No tail from head, no doubled head, no extra limbs, no yellow eyes. Both walking legs alternate, not five repeats of the same step. All upright and intermediate poses must be anatomically plausible. Count exactly five columns by nine rows. Transparent background.
